messages:
morgan (storage-eng): FYI saw a spike of failed restores in staging after last night's RBAC pruning. error shows KMS:Decrypt denied for backup-uploader-01 service account.

sam (sre-oncall): omg, rolling RBAC job ran at 03:12 — @liyah were uploads/restore grants part of the sweep?

liyah (runtime): we removed a handful of broad grants and replaced with scoped roles per ticket infra-4673. thought we kept kms:Decrypt for uploader SA, will check.

morgan (storage-eng): logs: `restore failed: access denied (kms:Decrypt) key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/abcd-ef01` — seen on 12 restore attempts between 03:30-03:45.

security-bot: Incident detected: multiple restore failures for staging db backups. Severity: P2. Links: https://ops.internal/incidents/INC-2026-11233

eva (eng-security): tagging this as encops triage. two frontlines: 1) why grants removed, 2) audit trail for who changed the role. also want to confirm no plaintext uploads leaked.

sam (sre-oncall): @liyah can you paste the RBAC diffs from the job? quick grep would help: `git show ${PR} -- roles/backup-uploader.yml`

liyah (runtime): diff shows we changed iam:RolePolicy to deny wildcard on kms:* and replaced with kms:GenerateDataKey+Decrypt? (intended). but the policy referenced an older key alias. looks like grant scoped to `alias/backup-v2` while snapshots use `alias/backup-v1`.

morgan (storage-eng): ah — uploader SA still has Decrypt against v1 key in prod, but staging key rotated to v2 last week. RBAC job removed cross-key wildcard grant during cleanup. so staging lost Decrypt.

eva (eng-security): good catch. action plan: (A) re-add kms:Decrypt for uploader SA scoped to alias/backup-v2 in staging (temporary), (B) add preflight check to RBAC sweep to detect cross-key dependency, (C) audit log correlation to identify who rotated staging CMK and why.

sam (sre-oncall): re-add in 10m and rollback the sweep change for staging only. I'll open a one-line approval change and patch.

liyah (runtime): creating PR now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/changes/PR-1429 — will include explanation and tests.

morgan (storage-eng): while we fix, confirm whether any snapshot blobs were uploaded unencrypted? I ran a quick s3 scan and saw no unencrypted objects for staging bucket.

eva (eng-security): good. we still need to verify audit logs for KMS grants and key rotation timeline. sam, can you pull CloudTrail entries for `kms:ScheduleKeyRotation` and `CreateGrant` between Mar 18 02:00-04:00?

sam (sre-oncall): pulling. quick note: I see a `CreateGrant` at 03:05 by service account `keystore-rotator`, and a `RetireGrant` at 03:09. there's also a `DisableKey` event? hmm pulling full chain.

security-bot: Audit hint: check for grants with RetireGrant by principal `keystore-rotator@infra`. Also verify grant tokens.

eva (eng-security): sounds like rotation process created new key alias then retired previous grant without reissuing Decrypt grant to uploader SA. that's a process bug. we should update rotation playbook.

liyah (runtime): PR has the immediate fix. Will add unit test to ensure smb-role references active alias. also adding an integration check that a restore smoke test runs after RBAC sweep in staging.

morgan (storage-eng): can we also add an expensive-but-rare periodic job that simulates a restore to catch these failures? maybe weekly.

sam (sre-oncall): +1. But until fixed, I'm re-running a manual restore to confirm behavior after applying the quick grant.

eva (eng-security): followup tasks: 1) update RBAC sweep to detect key alias mismatches (owner: runtime), 2) update KMS rotation playbook to propagate grants to dependent roles (owner: eng-security + infra), 3) add smoke restore to sweep CI (owner: storage). I'll create tickets and link to PR.

morgan (storage-eng): creating ticket SEC-7781 with reproducer and attaching logs. putting playbook snippets in the ticket.

liyah (runtime): PR merged and applied to staging at 03:58. restores now succeed. test restore passed.

sam (sre-oncall): confirmed successful restore at 04:02. closing P2. please add postmortem note with timeline + policy change.

eva (eng-security): I'll draft a short postmortem and a one-pager on key rotation and dependent-role mapping. cc @security-ops. thanks all :thumbsup:

morgan (storage-eng): thanks team. learned: never rotate keys without a grant-propagation step and better CI.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-11233 resolved. Actions: RBAC sweep preflight, KMS rotation playbook update, restore smoke test.
